pages.text: $(l)Novice material conversion$()$(br2)The Arcane Reaction Vessel is crafted from Smooth Sourcestone, a Cauldron, ordinary Source Gems, a Source Jar, and a Hopper. It performs basic item, fluid, and Source conversions without requiring Blaze Rods or a Brewing Stand.

Four Glass, 250 mB water, and 200 Source produce one Nether Quartz in ten seconds. Sixty-four Stone, 2,000 mB water, and 800 Source become 64 Infested Stone in five seconds for a Novice Vitalic Source farm. Source is paid when work starts; redstone pauses and blocked output preserves progress.
